sentence: Never serve delectious to someone too Turk to taste it.

wombos.definition: A state of being both delectable and delicious simultaneously — food or an experience so good that one superlative is not enough.
wombos.example: Those chicken tenders were absolutely delectious.

wombos.definition: A blend of toughness and Kirk energy — someone or something that is both hard and effortlessly cool.
wombos.example: That fit was straight Turk — nobody could say otherwise.
